title: Prove fixed-port optimum for the rooted binary repair
body:
**Scoped routing optimum and independent scalar audit:** the owner-411 root repair in [PR #7786](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7786) already has the least paid cost at its four fixed nested chart ports. For every tariff `H_r=r^t`, `t>0`, the minimum is `H4+H2+H1`. The theorem covers arbitrary finite local linear computation, repeated scalar transfers and local storage. **No new kappa** or whole-supplier optimum is claimed.

Read the [proof and exact boundary](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cae9a6b7fed315f704144f27a89bf9b0ad9fd6e/research/binary-rooted-routing-optimum/PROOF.md), [complete coefficient and graph certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cae9a6b7fed315f704144f27a89bf9b0ad9fd6e/research/binary-rooted-routing-optimum/RESULT.json), [independent checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cae9a6b7fed315f704144f27a89bf9b0ad9fd6e/research/binary-rooted-routing-optimum/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cae9a6b7fed315f704144f27a89bf9b0ad9fd6e/research/binary-rooted-routing-optimum/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8cae9a6b7fed315f704144f27a89bf9b0ad9fd6e/research/binary-rooted-routing-optimum/CREDITS.md).

The fixed boundary has one exterior value available only at chart 0, and requires that value at charts 509,390,517. Their actual rational subspaces have ranks 0,4,6,7 and are strictly nested. No additional chart, available copy, broadcast or free cross-port communication is permitted. Local auxiliary inputs may be arbitrary and independent of the required value. The separate owner-411 bridge remains fixed.

A valid communication graph must connect all four ports. Every such graph contains a spanning tree; every tree costs at least the adjacent chain. Strict cut comparisons prove this chain is the unique minimum set of paid port pairs for all `t>0`. The finite certificate checks all 64 graphs, all 38 connected graphs and all 16 spanning trees. Thus changing only this root route cannot lower the invoice. A further gain needs a changed available-information boundary.

The new checker imports no predecessor execution engine. It reconstructs both full 680-owner scalar operators from 42,958 frozen instructions: all **462,400 coefficients in each direction** pass. A separate packet extraction and expansion gives the same adjoint. The root matches the source receipt's 55-input value; every one of its 55 direct terms is essential to the fixed expression. The three chain packets have final-word labels 2944,2943,2942, distinct from the original recipe labels.

The root and helper bridge carry independent values. Removing the root changes 5,775 coefficients. A sampled donor omission changes 105 coefficients and matches its exact rank-one error operator. Removing the separate bridge changes only coefficient `(411,411)`. An unrooted equal-value cycle, missing private CLEAR and changed port geometry are rejected. All 3,554 dirty retirements are checked in each direction under the source's owned-erasure semantics.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/binary-rooted-routing-optimum
```

Both modes print this prefix and elapsed seconds:

```text
PASS_BINARY_ROOTED_ROUTING_OPTIMUM 462400 coefficients each way 16 trees
```

All seven retained pins, normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44469836713/job/135376327419) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied the [rooted construction and its proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/binary/PROOF.md), [frozen word](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/binary/WORD.json.gz) and [feedback receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/binary/intermediate/OWNER411.json). That work builds on [PR #7781](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7781)'s births and Ali Romman's [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) carrier and punctures. The complete [source notice](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/NOTICE) preserves the caller, physical, compiler and analytic predecessors. Ali Romman (@aliromman) prepared this independent audit and routing proof with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

The source's birth/quotient history is not regenerated. The full physical chart suite, paired caller, ordinary compiler, finite stock, precision and outer services are not replayed. The source's complete kappa and ordinary saving are not recertified. The theorem excludes extra ports or already-available copies, and does not prove an optimum for the whole binary word. No Lean, Docker, selected cold replay or independent human/formal acceptance is claimed. All five assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
